# Sketch

Sketch is a simple command-line tool for drawing sketches. It supports basic shapes like _line_, _rectangle_, _circle_` etc.
It uses plain text format and makes it easier to work with usual unix commands.

## Install

Install sketch using the following command:

```
python3 -m pip install craft-of-computing
```

## Basic Usage

Getting help:

```bash
sketch --help
```

```bash
echo hello
```

```{bash}
echo hello
```


## Getting Started

Draw a circle

```sketch
sketch circle 200 200 100 | sketch live
```

Draw two concentric circles.

```sketch
sketch circle 200 200 50 > a.sk
sketch circle 200 200 100 >> a.sk
sketch live a.sk
```

Ten concentric circles.

```sketch

for r in `seq 10 10 100`
do
    sketch circle 200 200 $r
done > a.sk
sketch live a.sk
```
